title: Integrated biodiesel and biopolymer production from Nannochloropsis biomass: a closed-loop biorefinery approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42513-42521
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02952J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
N. Nirmala, J. Arun, Sivasubramanian Palanisamy, R. S. Ernest Ravindran, Mohamed Abbas, Shaeen Kalathil, Md Zillur Rahman
A closed-loop biorefinery using Nannochloropsis sp. achieved 90.4% biodiesel conversion and 39% PHB yield from deoiled biomass, demonstrating sustainable dual production of biofuel and biopolymer for a circular bioeconomy.
